newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa's Bebear sees Paribas results up.
newsitem.headline: Axa's Bebear sees Paribas results up.

text.p: Claude Bebear, chief executive of French insurer Axa, expects Cie Financiere de Paribas' results to improve, afternoon daily Le Monde reported on Monday.
He also said he expected Paribas shares to rise.

"The results at Paribas are progressing very strongly," Bebear told Le Monde. "That is the fruit of efforts undertaken over several years. This recovery is, I think, sustainable. When markets see in 1997 that this turnaround is confirmed, there will be a positive movement for the share," he said.
Axa owns 10.7 percent of Paribas after Axa's merger, announced last November 12, with Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP).
At 1121 GMT, Paribas shares were trading at 346.2 francs, up 1.11 percent. Axa shares were up 0.61 percent at 332.0 francs.
